description: Trigger and catalog, on two realizations. Where the host runs hooks modules (Claude Code with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1) `modules` loads hooks/route.ts, which carries both, and the command hooks yield. Elsewhere: SessionStart injects the derived deficit table once per context epoch with an opener conditioned on the source — scripts/route-session.mjs; UserPromptSubmit carries the per-prompt firing conditions for /route — scripts/route-prompt.mjs.
